lead: `peek.py`'s `:@name` selector takes the symbol as it is *written*, so a `Type::method` spelling lands somewhere else or nowhere.
body: `object.rs:@ClassTable::define` printed `set_field_tags`, whose doc comment merely *mentions* `ClassTable::define`, and `@NvsObj::set_field` answered "no definition or mention" for a method three screens down — an inherent method is written `pub fn set_field`, and the `impl` block's name is not part of the token. Ask for the bare name (`@set_field`), or `--locate set_field`, and read the `impl` off the anchor.
